memory_update.text: MKSI is the strongest US-listed candidate for the plating equipment and chemistry sub-node because Atotech directly serves PCB, IC substrate, and advanced-packaging plating processes.
ONTO and CAMT form the inspection/metrology lane for substrate and advanced-packaging yield bottlenecks; both require later verification of AI accelerator or ABF substrate-specific customer exposure.

ENTG is a broader materials/purity and substrate-handling proxy for advanced packaging; inclusion is valid but less pure than MKSI because advanced-packaging substrate exposure may be diluted by broader semiconductor materials cycles.

The purest ABF/build-up film and high-end substrate names are mostly non-US listed: Ajinomoto, Ibiden, Shinko, Unimicron, Nan Ya PCB, and AT&S. US-listed exposure is therefore mainly second-order through tools, chemistry, inspection, and materials infrastructure.
For later Serenity layers, prioritize evidence that ties each US-listed supplier to AI accelerator substrate capacity, not just generic advanced packaging or semiconductor capex.
